quotations.old_english: Tó þon þ-bar; hí þone swétan mete húru sworettende and geómriende onbyrgdon
quotations.latin: ut cibum suavem saltem suspirando gustarent

source_text: sworettan. Add :-- Tó þon þ-bar; hí þone swétan mete húru sworettende and geómriende onbyrgdon ut cibum suavem saltem suspirando gustarent, Gr. D. 170, 10.
